  1. Students must earn a \"C\" grade or higher in all lower-division courses and upper-division non-studio courses applied to the Studio Art program.
  2. A minimum grade of \"B\" is required in all upper-division studio courses.
  3. It is recommended students complete all lower-division requirements before enrolling in upper-division courses at Sacramento State.
  4. ART 22, 24, 40, 50, 53, 88, and PHOT 40 are listed in more than one area of the major and may not satisfy multiple major requirements. For example, if ART 22 is completed to satisfy the Two-Dimensional Studio Group requirement (Section D), it may not be used to also satisfy the Lower-Division Studio Elective Group (Section F).
  5. The department also offers a degree in Art. See the \"Art, BA\" major for additional information.
  6. For additional information, please visit: Department of Art.
